title: Light Switch
description: Every switch flips itself and its neighbours. Can you turn off all the lights? Fifty handmade-by-maths levels that start easy and get tricky.
instructions: Click or tap a light to flip it and the lights next to it.
Keyboard: move with the arrow keys, flip with Space or Enter.
Turn every light off to finish the level.
Stuck? Press R to restart the level.
